Results.ReviewText:
Bought this new for Xmas.  Had the vendor assemble and deliver for free. The fit and finish of the unit is excellent. The drop-down left side table is very stable for lifting and rolling the unit. The weight of the LP tank on the opposite side acts as a counter-balance, so it doesn't take a lot of strength lifting to roll the unit out of the way.

I appreciate the instructional emails I've received specific to this model. Very helpful.

I've grilled with it a couple of times now and it preheats to 550+ in about 10 minutes at 40 degrees ambient. That's great for a two-burner unit.  I notice that the flame extends across the rear crossover tube as well.  So, it's almost like having 3 burners. Heat is even on all sides. I like the design of the grease handling system. 

I haven't always done the best job of maintenance of former gas or charcoal grills I've owned.  And they haven't lasted as long as I would have liked.  But with the easy maintenance process recommended for this grill, I'm sure I'll get more years of service from this solid unit than I ever have before.

Some reviews mention low overhead for rotisserie grilling, beer chicken, etc. With just the two of us to grill for, larger items are not going to be a problem.
Results.Title: Easy To Manage, Grill and Clean

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with our team. We are so sorry to learn you had an issue getting the temperature above 250. It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.



1. Open the lid

2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)

3. Turn your LP tank on all the way

4. Wait 30-60 seconds

5. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)

6. Hit your igniter

7. Turn on all remaining burners

8. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F

Our team has also reached out via email if further assistance is needed. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
